entities.name: Cauldron
entities.description: An Izzet League compound in Utvara that served as a massive geothermal power facility; destroyed in an explosion.

entities.name: Utvara
entities.description: Township and region supported by the Cauldron.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild that built and operated the Cauldron.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon leader of the Izzet who sent Zomaj Hauc to hatch the eggs and later blasted the ruined compound.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: Izzet magelord who operated the Cauldron and secretly schemed to overthrow Niv-Mizzet with dragons.

entities.name: Crix
entities.description: A dragon (the third, white one) who with Teysa Karlov chased Hauc; later planned to rebuild the Cauldron.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Rider aboard the white dragon who gave chase to Hauc.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane on which the Cauldron stood.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet learns of the ancient dragon eggs and sends Zomaj Hauc to establish an Izzet steamworks to incubate them.
events.quote: he sent Magelord Zomaj Hauc to the site to establish an Izzet steamworks there

events.summary: Hauc covertly schemes to force the hatching dragons to submit to him and overthrow Niv-Mizzet.
events.quote: covertly devising a scheme to force the three dragons to submit to his will upon hatching

events.summary: The Cauldron is attacked from without and by rebellion within; the steamworks collapse and one egg is crushed.
events.quote: the Cauldron facility was attacked both from without and from rebellion within simultaneously

events.summary: Hauc spellbinds the blue dragon and flies off, pursued by Crix and Teysa Karlov on the white dragon; the Cauldron is destroyed in explosions.
events.quote: Hauc managed to spellbind the second, blue, dragon and mount it

events.summary: A month later Niv-Mizzet blasts the ruined compound with dragonfire, melting the scrap into a metal lid.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet personally blasted the ruined compound with dragonfire

relations.quote: The Cauldron was the site of an Izzet League compound in Utvara

relations.note: ostensibly did the guildleader's bidding while plotting against him
relations.quote: ostensibly doing the bidding of the Izzet guildleader
giving him enough power to overthrow Niv-Mizzet
